Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. BEHERAI@INDIANO IL.IN Not Applicable Integrity Pact (IP) 6. 7. Pre-Qualification Criteria (PQC) Technical PQC:

Applicable 1. Bidder shall be the Original Manufacturer (OEM) of the “ATF Merox Pre-impregnated C atalyst/Activated Carbon” or Distributor authorized by the Original Manufacturer. If th e bidder is OEM, Bidder shall submit, along with the bid, relevant documents like Cert ificate of Incorporation, valid ISO certifications (ISO 9001/ISO 14001) in support of th eir claim as ‘Original Manufacturer’. Details of manufacturing locations (with addresses) and List of group companies / 7a. affiliates shall be provided. IOCL reserves the right to audit manufacturing facility, R& D lab, and verify OEM status prior to award or during contract. 2. If the bidder is Distributor, Bidder shall submit Valid Authorisation Letter or Agreemen t from OEM. Authorisation letter shall be on OEM letter head clearly mentioning prod uct name, product specification (as per OEM), validity period of distributorship. OEM s hall explicitly confirm Distributor is authorised to bid, supply, and provide technical s upport. OEM shall provide proof of being original manufacturer of the subject catalyst along with the above Authorisation letter/Agreement.Distributor shall confirm that the ir supplied Product(s) shall confirm to OEM product(s) specification. 3. Bidder offered “ATF Merox Pre-impregnated Catalyst/Activated Carbon” (in terms of gr ades/trade name) must have been previously supplied to at least one of the Refinery/ Petrochemical plants India/worldwide in the last Seven (7) years. Documentary evide nce in the form of executed Work Order/ Purchase Order are to be submitted along w ith the bid. 4. “ATF Merox Pre-impregnated Catalyst/Activated Carbon” offered by the bidder must h ave proven track record with satisfactorily performance [for at least two years in last seven (7) years]. Certificate of Satisfactory Performance from at least one customer/u ser or email from the customer as documentary evidence is to be submitted along wi th the bid. The offered ATF Merox Pre-impregnated Catalyst shall have processed simi lar feedstock (Minimum RSH of 350 wppm) In case, the bidder could not submit Performance certificate from User, they can submit a Self-cer tificate in support of Satisfactory Performance giving W.O/PO reference, User Organisation addres s, contact details etc. IOCL reserves the right to cross-verify, with the Customer/User, the support ing Documents submitted by the Bidder. If claims/documents are found dubious, IOCL-reserves t he right to reject such bidder. Commercial Experience PQC:

Applicable For experience, the order(s) executed by the bidder, during the last five years ending on the last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the original bid submission end date 7b. falls, should be considered as under:- Three orders each executed for “ATF Merox Pre-impregnated Catalyst/ Activated Charcoal” wher e executed value is not less than INR 93,22,000.00 OR Two orders each executed for “ATF Merox Pre-impregnated Catalyst/ Activated Charcoal” where executed value is not less than INR 1,24,29,000.00 OR One order executed for “ATF Merox Pre-impregnated Catalyst/ Activated Charcoal” where execu ted value is not less than INR 1,55,36,000.00 Note:- Please refer “INSTRUCTION FOR COMPLIANCE OF PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (PQC)” for required documents to fulfil commercial experience PQ Criteria. Financial PQC Applicable The annual turnover of the bidders during any of the preceding three financial years should be at least INR 1,86,44,000.00 7c. Note:- Please refer “INSTRUCTION FOR COMPLIANCE OF PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (PQC)” for required documents to fulfil Financial PQ Criteria. Delivery Period for Supply Our preferred delivery period for supply is 03 months. The bidder to quote their earliest firm delivery period. This delivery period shall be reckoned from the date of GeM Order. Date of LR / RR / Coastal Bill 8a. of Lading shall be considered as Date of Delivery. NOTE:- IOCL reserves the right to reject any deviation to delivery terms not meeting IOCL’s requirement after giving one chance to the bidder to accept IOCL’s requirement. Time Period For Site Work/ Services Refer Technical Specifications and Scope of Work 8b. Third Party Inspection Not Applicable 9. IBR Not Applicable 10. Payment Term 100% payment will be released within thirty (30) days after receipt and acceptance of material at site and on-line submission of bills. 11.

Guarantee/Warranty (Defect liability period) Refer Technical Specifications and Scope of Work 12. PWCAMC/PWAMC Not Applicable 13. Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Vendor shall furnish PBG/ISB equivalent to 5% of the order value valid till full defect liability perio d plus two months claim period i.e., Total 41 Months (03 Months Delivery Period plus 36 Months f or Defect Liability Period plus 2 Months for Claim Period). PBG/ISB as stated above shall be furnis hed within 15 days of order. In case of increase in the order value due to an amendment, the PB 14. G/ISB value shall be proportionately increased. SPECIAL NOTE FOR PBG:- PBG requirement shall be relaxed by 50% in case of MSEs owned by SC/ST & Women Entreprene urs. Site Work Refer Technical Specifications and Scope of Work 15. Tendered item quantity Divisible / Non-Divisible 16. Item Quantity is Non Divisible Applicability of DMIS policy 17. Not Applicable Minimum % of Local Content required in this tender CLASS 1 – Minimum 50% Local Content (For Purchase Preference) 18. CLASS 2 - Minimum 20% Local Content (For participation) In case item is imported and bidder has participated as reseller, OEM certificate for country of ori gin to be submitted. Authorization to submit bids When a bidder submits quotation for an item manufactured by some different company, the bidd 19. er is also required to attach, in its quotation, the manufacturer's authorization certificate and man ufacturer's confirmation of extending the required warranty for that product. In case of any conflict in the terms mentioned in this BUYER ADDED BID SPECIFI C ATC and elsewhere in the tender, the terms indicated in BUYER ADDED BID S PECIFIC ATC shall supersede. In the event of any irreconcilable conflicts, the hie rarchy for the acceptance shall be– · Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
